warnings: READS SOURCE ONLY — never calls a deployed function, so it cannot observe a live 429; it can only confirm the source calls withinLimits with a real LIMITS config, the same mechanism the working examples use. Applying nothing, deploying nothing.
NONE of the 16 declared public endpoints is known-open. Every one reads as protected in source. This is a result, not an empty default: anything genuinely unprotected would be listed here by name.

accept-invite (team-invite acceptance) is public — it is in deploy-functions.mjs's PUBLIC_FUNCTIONS set, so it deploys with verify_jwt=false, because an invitee has no session yet. ROADMAP 14.13, 2026-09-23: it now carries the same LIMITS.publicCeiling guard and is a declared target of this check. Its token is 192 bits of randomness (encode(gen_random_bytes(24),'hex')), so it was never guessable — THIS WAS A COST ITEM, NOT A SECURITY HOLE, and should not be read as one later.

dimensions.limit_used: LIMITS.publicCeiling (per-caller IP, 600/hour) — the same blunt ceiling every other read-only public endpoint uses; per-address, not per-business or global, checked against _shared/rateLimit.ts before reuse because a per-business limit would never fire for a caller with no business context yet.
